title: Schema for the requirements data file: what a record (a product, a mission, ...) requires or expands

content_type.description: The collection of the record that requires or expands the source.

content_id.description: The record's id in that collection.

relation.description: requires: the record can only be played with the source; expands: the record adds to the source.

source_id.description: Foreign key to the source in data/sources.json that is required or expanded.
